dialogue_parser_tokens.mode_effect: A successful brace-token comparison sets this+0x582=1; this mode changes the entry-count arithmetic and can produce 14-pixel line spacing when overflow is also set.
dialogue_parser_tokens.entry_count_proof: The parser computes paint_count=max(raw_count-6,0), then clamps paint_count to 16; raw_count is incremented by segment separators and token handling, so it is not simply the number of visible text lines.

paint_order.evidence: When the primary resource path is active, Frame 1100 is selected and passed through the original 800x600 compositor using this+0x520/0x524 placement fields.
Frame 1101 is selected inside the count-controlled loop, with per-entry 18-byte source stride and per-entry target Y progression.
After the repeated-entry loop, the last entry index is clamped and Frame 1102 is selected and composited at this+0x540/this+0x544 plus the final 18-pixel offset.
When the primary resource path is unavailable, the function enters a separate normalized/alpha composition branch using 0x4542A0; it is not proven to be business text rendering.

confirmed: The NPC window is initialized from GameInter.wil Frame 1100 at 552x176.
The NPC object separately loads Data/NPCFace.WIL into owner+0x278; this is distinct from the GameInter handle used by the window and child controls.
The paint path selects consecutive Frames 1100, 1101 and 1102.
The dynamic list uses a count at this+0x51C and an 18-byte per-entry stride.
All three child controls have statically recovered window-relative positions.
The NPC paint entry statically orders the primary Frame 1100 composition, repeated Frame 1101 entries, final Frame 1102 entry and fallback composition branch.
